characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: If zombies trap you in a beach town, don't run for the roads. Run for the water.
Kai opened his surf shop at six, like every morning.
Could be worse, he said. It was about to get much worse.
At six fifteen, the screaming started.
A girl ran in. Fifteen. Blood on her sleeve. Not hers.
Outside, a man walked toward the glass. Grey skin. White eyes.
Kai locked the door and jammed every surfboard he owned against it.
By noon there were ten of them. By sunset, forty.
The radio said one thing. Stay indoors.
But Tess noticed something. They walked right up to the waves, and stopped.
Front door, forty infected. Back door, the ocean. And two longboards.
Tess had never surfed. It was dark. And the tide was going out.
Kai grabbed both boards. When I say go, he said, run for the water.
Paddle out? Part two is next.
